episode_summary: Barely Informed News marks Friday the 13th with a silent Jason Voorhees interview before pivoting to an AI-generated Minecraft civilization and the 2024 IG Nobel Prizes, where Chet Manscape demonstrates anal respiration techniques. Jeb Nogget's instructional segment descends into a live pants-soiling incident and a ghost-dad timeout, while Rick details Trump and Vance's escalating Haitian migrant rhetoric and the proposed DOGE task force. The broadcast closes with Crum's medical case study on penile food poisoning and DJ Newsic's AI-assisted Creed parody for Garth.
